articles.title: Imagine a Battery That Charges in a Quadrillionth of a Second!
articles.summary: Scientists built a tiny quantum battery that charges with a laser faster than you can blink — and could last for years. It uses weird quantum tricks, not chemicals, to store energy.

articles.title: No Secret Scenes! What You Need to Know About Mortal Kombat 2's Credits
articles.summary: The new Mortal Kombat II movie has zero post-credits scenes — no mid-credits, no end-credits, nothing. Once the credits roll, you can head straight for the exit.

articles.title: Bad Bunny's New Logo Has Fans Guessing: Is a Big Change Coming?
articles.summary: Bad Bunny showed up at the Met Gala dressed as a grandpa and debuted a logo with his real name, Benito Antonio. He's trademarking the name — maybe for a clothing line!
